name: Dot Flood
description: A matrix of small square dots that floods across a surface from a point and keeps shimmering, usually inside a card on hover or focus.

props.name: active
props.description: Shows the dots when true and recedes them when false. Leave it unset to reveal once on mount.

props.name: colors
props.description: One to three dot colours, mixed at random across the grid. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Side of each square dot, in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between neighbouring dots, in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the wave and the shimmer. At 1 the wave crosses the surface in about 0.6 seconds and recedes in about 0.35.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the wave starts. `pointer` floods from the point where the pointer entered the parent element and recedes toward the point where it left; keyboard focus falls back to the centre.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the layer, which is absolutely positioned to fill its nearest positioned parent. Other div props are passed through.
